R0250.title: Edge Function Configuration Abuse
R0250.definition: Misconfigured edge functions or WAF rules cause authentication bypass, data forwarding, or traffic hijacking.
R0250.description:
Edge function configuration abuse occurs when CDN edge functions, Workers, WAF rules, or traffic orchestration logic are misconfigured. Attackers may bypass authentication, forward sensitive requests, alter responses, or create an open proxy.

Edge logic sits between users and origin services, so mistakes affect the full traffic entry point. Changes need review, staged rollout, least privilege, and rollback mechanisms.
R0250.influence: Abused edge functions can cause authentication bypass, data forwarding, response tampering, and broad traffic disruption.

observables: Auth-bypass appears after edge function or WAF rule changes
Edge logic is configured to forward sensitive requests or act as an open proxy
The traffic ingress layer shows anomalous response tampering or data forwarding
Edge config changes lack canary release and rollback, causing widespread service anomalies
Edge functions carry excessive permissions unconstrained by least privilege
